title: HealthInformatics EDTriageModelLaunch

stats.done_summary: Completed ED Triage Model Evaluation comparing TriageAssist-B (candidate) vs TriageAssist-A (production). Analysis included offline evaluation (n=8,000 test set) and 14-day online A/B pilot. Key findings: TriageAssist-B shows improved sensitivity (+7.3%) and faster physician times (-14.8%) but significant concerns including 49.4% worse calibration, 64.9% higher LWBS rate, 36.6% more returns, 69.8% more clinician overrides, and 127.3% more patient complaints. Recommendation: DO NOT EXPAND TriageAssist-B until calibration and specificity issues are addressed. Deliverables: analysis code (code/), intermediate results (outputs/), 5 visualization figures (report/images/), and comprehensive report (report/report.md).
